observations.why: Speaker names a principal whose authority frames the announcement that follows; the address-form enacts rank by attributing the decision to a named leader.

The principal enacts authority-ranking by declaring an adoption decision for the collective ('We are adopting'), while the performance-justification ('15x faster') introduces market-pricing proportionality as the rationale.

The animator reframes the principal's announcement as a ratified decision record ('Key decisions:'), re-enacting authority-ranking, while the performance metric carries market-pricing proportionality.
